name: ORBITS
content:
EXAM:
CT Orbits [with or without] Intravenous Contrast.

CLINICAL HISTORY:

TECHNIQUE:
Axial computed tomography images of the orbits [with or without]  intravenous contrast. Dose reduction technique was used including one or more of the following: automated exposure control, adjustment of mA and kV according to patient size, and/or iterative reconstruction. 

CONTRAST:
[With and without];

COMPARISON:
None provided.

FINDINGS:

ORBITS:
Unremarkable. No retrobulbar hematoma. No post-septal fat stranding or fluid 

BONES:
No acute fracture or focal osseous lesion. No periosteal reaction. 

SINUSES:
No sinus air-fluid level as visualized.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue gas. No radiopaque foreign body. 

IMPRESSION:
1. No acute orbital abnormalities.
